item.title: Abstraction Attraction
item.description: Introduction Abstraction is a foundational aspect of programming. It allows us as the programmers, to take what is a potentially complex, cumbersome, or perhaps simply an inconvenient system, and expose only what you deem to be important, whilst hiding any unnecessary details.
